conditional_integrals: Both normalized Gaussian densities integrate to 1 over R.
contour_geometry: For the covariance eigenvalues 1+rho and 1-rho, a Mahalanobis contour at radius c has semiaxes c*sqrt(1+rho) and c*sqrt(1-rho); positive rho gives the +45 degree major axis.
zero_denominator_semantics: At a zero-marginal conditioning value a regular conditional version must be chosen in advance and is unique only marginal-almost-everywhere; both displayed Gaussian marginal denominators are strictly positive.
manual_reason: Every displayed formula, approximation, normalization statement, slice-to-conditional relationship, and contour orientation recomputes correctly from the same bivariate normal model.
